title: Brother and Sister Join Forces
next_chapter_hook: Just as the three were about to step out of the secret realm, Chen Nian's words made Chen Ji pause—behind the Holy Sect, there was actually the Shadow Empire? That colossal beast hidden behind the clouds was quietly watching this world.

text.content: The power of the Heavenly Fate Key surged from Chen Nian's body like a tide, and this force resonated with the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's body, weaving a brilliant crimson rainbow bridge between the siblings. The Holy Sect's pursuers hadn't even drawn near when they were sent flying by this force.

dialogue.content: Brother, all these years... I've been waiting for you to come take me away.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this familiar yet unfamiliar face before him, his throat barely moving. Years of schemes and planning finally held the most tangible meaning at this moment. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions, and said coldly: 'Less talk, let's get out of here alive first.'

dialogue.content: Northeast direction, three o'clock, four Golden Core stage pursuers, approaching in encirclement formation. Give me seven breaths of time.

text.content: Before his words even finished, the Heavenly Fate Key power around Chen Nian suddenly solidified, transforming into nine golden chains that darted through the void like spirit serpents. She let out a light rebuke, and the chains precisely entangled the nearest pursuer's wrist, dragging him ruthlessly against the rocky wall.

dialogue.content: Everything the Holy Sect taught me, I didn't learn it for nothing. Brother, leave the rest to you!

text.content: A cold, mocking smile traced Chen Ji's lips. The Tianji Record Fragment materialized in his palm. He didn't动用那珍贵的fate, instead relying on years of combat-hardened instincts, a black dagger discreetly sliding into his grasp. Waste? That's merely an illusion for outsiders.

choice.prompt: The four Golden Core stage pursuers have closed to within ten zhang, and Chen Ji must make a split-second decision—

choices.description: Form a partnership with Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate Key power, one close-range and one long-range, eliminating pursuers one by one
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate pursuers without casualties, sibling coordination improved
choices.risk_hint: If coordination fails, may fall into encirclement

text.content: Chen Ji's dagger struck like a venomous snake, aimed at the nearest cultivator's lower dantian—this was an acupoint blind spot he'd studied for years. At the same instant, Chen Nian's golden chains flanked from the side, entangling another pursuer's limbs. The siblings worked in perfect tandem, front and back, seamless as one.

dialogue.content: Brother, the one on the left is trying to escape!

choices.description: Deliberately reveal flaws to lure pursuers into pre-set traps, using terrain advantage to annihilate the enemy
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming one use of Tianji Record foresight
choices.visible_reward: Defeat the enemy without fighting, pursuers may turn on each other
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record consumption is significant, subsequent combat power may be insufficient

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, the Tianji Record Fragment flickering in the depths of his pupils. Three breaths later, he had already 'seen' their weakness—the leader was a glory-hunting incompetent, while the other three were already resentful.

dialogue.content: Heh, so they're nothing but a rabble after all.

choices.description: Completely let Chen Nian unleash her Heavenly Fate Key power, handle covering the retreat herself
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Chen Nian's hidden ability 'Heavenly Fate Resonance'
choices.risk_hint: Cannot predict Chen Nian's combat style

text.content: Chen Ji didn't speak much, only gave a slight nod. This subtle gesture, seen by Chen Nian, carried more weight than a thousand words—Brother finally willing to trust her. Her eyes grew warm, and the pent-up grievance of being imprisoned for years instantly transformed into overwhelming battle intent.

dialogue.content: Alright, then let me show Brother what the Holy Sect taught me in these five years!

text.content: The battle erupted in chaos. Chen Nian's golden chains and Chen Ji's dagger formed perfect complements—chains binding enemies, blade taking lives. In mere moments, three of the four Golden Core pursuers had fallen, with only the leader still desperately resisting.

dialogue.content: Is this the strength of a Holy Sect Inner Disciple? No wonder they could only send someone to chase a 'waste'.

text.content: The man's face turned deathly pale, but not daring to linger, he turned to flee. However, Chen Nian was prepared, a golden chain shooting out like lightning, precisely entangling his ankle.

dialogue.content: Brother, what should we do with this person?

choice.prompt: The last pursuer lay subdued on the ground, and Chen Ji needed to decide how to handle this escaped fish—

choices.description: Cut the grass and remove the roots, leave no future trouble
choices.visible_cost: Bear the burden of murder, may沾染因果
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate risk of exposing identity
choices.risk_hint: Holy Sect may investigate the murderer's identity

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold, his dagger without hesitation sweeping across the man's throat. Blood gushed forth, staining the dead leaves beneath his feet. He wiped the blade expressionlessly, as if he had just done something trivial.

choices.description: Keep them to gather intelligence on the Holy Sect, erase memory after soul-searching
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Holy Sect internal intelligence, may turn or exploit them
choices.risk_hint: If the other party refuses to break, all previous efforts wasted

text.content: Chen Ji crouched down, his fingertip lightly touching the man's Brow Center. A pure spiritual consciousness invaded the man's Mental Sea, the Golden Core cultivator's defenses as fragile as paper before him. After a moment, Chen Ji sneered: 'Interesting, the Holy Sect left some tricks up their sleeve.'

choices.description: Deliberately let this person escape to report back,借此向圣宗传递某种信息
choices.visible_reward: Holy Sect may misjudge the situation, possibly withdraw main forces
choices.risk_hint: The other party may bring more pursuers

text.content: Chen Ji patted the man's face, his tone terrifyingly gentle: 'Go back and tell your Sect Master—the Heavenly Fate Key... the Chen family wants it.' He deliberately wore a meaningful smile, letting the man scramble away into the distance.

Having dealt with the pursuers, the transmission array at the secret realm's exit was already faintly visible. Chen Ji had just relaxed when a familiar wave of demonic energy surged from the side—Ye Qing's figure flickered like a ghost, her face wearing an ambiguous expression of amusement.

dialogue.content: Chen Gongzi, your waste persona is truly deeply ingrained. If news of that earlier battle spread, those dogs at Tianqing Sect would surely be shattered.
If news leaks, Ye Sacred Maiden might also be implicated.

text.content: Ye Qing laughed lightly, unperturbed. Her gaze fell on Chen Nian, a flash of surprise flickering in her eyes: 'So this is the host of the Heavenly Fate Key? Indeed... different from ordinary women.' Chen Nian frowned slightly, but said nothing, unconsciously stepping half a pace closer to Chen Ji.

The three passed through the transmission array, the scenery before them abruptly changing. Outside the secret realm, the night sky sparkled with countless stars, and the distant outline of Tianqing Sect loomed hazily. Chen Ji turned back to glance at the secret realm entrance, confirming no new pursuers before finally exhaling in relief.

dialogue.content: Brother, there's something I must tell you. The Holy Sect... is not the mastermind of this matter.

choice.prompt: The deeper meaning in Chen Nian's words made Chen Ji's brow furrow slightly—behind the Holy Sect, there were other forces?

choices.description: Immediately ask Chen Nian everything she knows
choices.risk_hint: There may be Holy Sect spies nearby

text.content: Chen Ji's expression tightened, he lowered his voice: 'Speak.' Chen Nian surveyed her surroundings, confirming no one present before slowly opening her mouth: 'Behind the Holy Sect Sacred Maiden selection are people from the Great Zhou Dynasty. They need the Heavenly Fate Key to open an ancient ruin.'

choices.description: Find a safe place to rest first, then inquire in detail
choices.visible_cost: Delay returning to sect, may arouse suspicion
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence without exposing whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: Tianqing Sect may send people to search

text.content: Chen Ji decisively shook his head: 'This is not a place to talk.' He surveyed his surroundings, his gaze falling on a distant hidden valley: 'Let's go there first.' Ye Qing raised an eyebrow but didn't object, and the three figures quickly vanished into the night.

choices.description: First observe Ye Qing's reaction, then decide whether to reveal to Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Test Ye Qing's stance, deepen three-way trust
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing has ulterior motives, intelligence will be exposed

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, he glanced at Ye Qing without moving a muscle: 'Ye Sacred Maiden seems unsurprised?' Ye Qing met his gaze, a meaningful smile curving her lips: 'Chen Gongzi is indeed cautious. Regarding the imperial matter, I do know some things.'

Deep in the valley, Chen Ji lit a bonfire. The orange-red firelight illuminated the three faces, night wind brushing past, lifting the fringe of hair on Chen Nian's forehead. She was silent for a long while before finally speaking: 'Brother, imperial forces have already infiltrated the three major sects. What they want is not just the Heavenly Fate Key...'

dialogue.content: What they want is control over the entire cultivation world. The Holy Sect, Xuanwu Sect, Tianqing Sect... in their eyes, all are merely chess pieces.

text.content: Hearing this, Chen Ji's gaze darkened. Imperial power... this was a realm his years of scheming had never touched. In the foresight of the Tianji Record Fragment, such a massive chess game had never appeared. He suddenly realized that perhaps from the very beginning, he had been calculated against on an even deeper level. The bonfire crackled, the three shadows stretching long on the rock wall. Ye Qing suddenly said softly: 'It seems we have a common enemy.' Chen Ji did not speak, only stared at the dancing flames, an unprecedented sense of urgency rising in his heart. The world's chess game was far more complex than he had imagined. And his reunion with his sister might be the most critical move in this grand game.
